finding: Can reset probes separate learned habit priors from goal precision? In N11, all-probe true-mechanism log-loss gain is 0.270–0.724 nats across twelve settings. Pressure, context-shift and devaluation probes each have positive whole-law lower bounds in every setting. Automatizing effort falls from 0.603 to 0.137 by 32 records, while the three fixed mechanisms remain constant. All 12,288 cases, 168 independently reconstructed intervals and full replay verify. These are constructed mechanisms, not evidence about human automaticity or effort.
